verdict.rationale: Cursor documents genuine parallel-agent execution (cloud agents run 'as many agents as you want in parallel', fleets of agents, and subagents that can be launched simultaneously) plus Worktrees explicitly designed to 'start several agents on the same repo without conflicts,' giving each attempt isolated files/changes to inspect. However, no evidence describes a dedicated UI/workflow for comparing multiple attempts side-by-side and selecting a winner—only isolated execution and PR-attached artifacts for review of a single agent's output. Missing for 10: explicit multi-attempt comparison/diff UI, documented workflow for discarding losing attempts, and independent hands-on confirmation of comparing parallel task attempts.
